list.name: repo
list.label: Repository
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT repo AS __text, repo AS __value FROM quality_scan WHERE status = 'complete' ORDER BY repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo AS __text, repo AS __value FROM quality_scan WHERE status = 'complete' ORDER BY repo

list.name: branch
list.label: Branch
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT branch AS __text, branch AS __value FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY branch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT branch AS __text, branch AS __value FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY branch

list.name: commit
list.label: Commit
list.definition: SELECT LEFT(commit_sha, 12) || ' · ' || TO_CHAR(completed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, commit_sha AS __value FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC
list.query: SELECT LEFT(commit_sha, 12) || ' · ' || TO_CHAR(completed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, commit_sha AS __value FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM ci_run WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(tests_failed, 0) AS value FROM ci_run WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT coverage_line_rate * 100 AS value FROM ci_run WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT debt_minutes AS value FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT completed_at AS time, complexity AS "Cognitive complexity", cyclomatic AS "Cyclomatic complexity", debt_minutes AS "Debt minutes" FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' AND $__timeFilter(completed_at) ORDER BY completed_at

SELECT created_at AS time, coverage_line_rate * 100 AS "Coverage %", COALESCE(tests_failed, 0) AS "Failed tests" FROM ci_run WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: File-Level Risks
panels.description: Files with growth, duplication, high complexity density, poor cohesion, or enough size to deserve architectural review. First scans show no fabricated change value.

targets.rawSql: WITH current_scan AS (SELECT scan_id, repo, branch, commit_sha, completed_at FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1), previous_scan AS (SELECT quality_scan.scan_id FROM quality_scan, current_scan WHERE quality_scan.repo = current_scan.repo AND quality_scan.branch = current_scan.branch AND quality_scan.status = 'complete' AND quality_scan.completed_at < current_scan.completed_at ORDER BY quality_scan.completed_at DESC LIMIT 1), worst_functions AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (function_metric.path) function_metric.path, function_metric.symbol, function_metric.complexity FROM current_scan JOIN quality_function_metric function_metric ON function_metric.scan_id = current_scan.scan_id ORDER BY function_metric.path, function_metric.complexity DESC, function_metric.cyclomatic DESC), ranked AS (SELECT current_metric.*, CASE WHEN previous_metric.scan_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE current_metric.complexity - previous_metric.complexity END AS complexity_change, COALESCE(worst_function.symbol, '—') AS worst_function, COALESCE(worst_function.complexity, 0) AS worst_function_complexity FROM current_scan JOIN quality_file_metric current_metric ON current_metric.scan_id = current_scan.scan_id LEFT JOIN quality_file_metric previous_metric ON previous_metric.scan_id = (SELECT scan_id FROM previous_scan) AND previous_metric.path = current_metric.path LEFT JOIN worst_functions worst_function ON worst_function.path = current_metric.path) SELECT ranked.path AS "File", ranked.code_lines AS "LOC", ROUND(ranked.complexity * 100.0 / NULLIF(ranked.code_lines, 0), 1) AS "Cognitive / 100 LOC", ranked.complexity_change AS "Complexity change", ROUND(ranked.duplicated_lines * 100.0 / NULLIF(ranked.code_lines, 0), 1) AS "Duplication %", ranked.lcom4 AS "LCOM4", ranked.worst_function AS "Worst function", ranked.worst_function_complexity AS "Worst cognitive", current_scan.repo, current_scan.commit_sha, 1 AS start_line, GREATEST(ranked.lines, 1) AS end_line, 'File risk' AS selection_kind, ranked.path AS selection_label, ranked.complexity AS selection_cognitive, ranked.cyclomatic AS selection_cyclomatic FROM current_scan JOIN ranked ON TRUE WHERE ranked.complexity_change > 0 OR ranked.duplicated_lines > 0 OR ranked.code_lines >= 200 OR ranked.lcom4 > 1 OR (ranked.code_lines >= 50 AND ranked.complexity * 100.0 / NULLIF(ranked.code_lines, 0) >= 10) ORDER BY ranked.complexity_change DESC NULLS LAST, ranked.duplicated_lines * 100.0 / NULLIF(ranked.code_lines, 0) DESC NULLS LAST, ranked.complexity * 100.0 / NULLIF(ranked.code_lines, 0) DESC NULLS LAST, ranked.complexity DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Complex Functions
panels.description: Only functions that crossed Qlty's function-complexity threshold. Each row uses the exact range from that finding rather than an unrelated smell or a line-1 fallback.

targets.rawSql: WITH current_scan AS (SELECT scan_id, repo, branch, commit_sha, completed_at FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1), previous_scan AS (SELECT quality_scan.scan_id FROM quality_scan, current_scan WHERE quality_scan.repo = current_scan.repo AND quality_scan.branch = current_scan.branch AND quality_scan.status = 'complete' AND quality_scan.completed_at < current_scan.completed_at ORDER BY quality_scan.completed_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT current_metric.symbol AS "Function", current_metric.path AS "File", current_metric.code_lines AS "LOC", current_metric.complexity AS "Cognitive", CASE WHEN previous_metric.scan_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE current_metric.complexity - previous_metric.complexity END AS "Complexity change", current_metric.cyclomatic AS "Cyclomatic", ROUND(current_metric.complexity * 100.0 / NULLIF(current_metric.code_lines, 0), 1) AS "Cognitive / 100 LOC", current_scan.repo, current_scan.commit_sha, function_finding.start_line, function_finding.end_line, 'Complex function' AS selection_kind, current_metric.symbol AS selection_label, current_metric.complexity AS selection_cognitive, current_metric.cyclomatic AS selection_cyclomatic FROM current_scan JOIN quality_function_metric current_metric ON current_metric.scan_id = current_scan.scan_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT finding.start_line, COALESCE(finding.end_line, finding.start_line) AS end_line FROM quality_finding finding WHERE finding.scan_id = current_scan.scan_id AND finding.path = current_metric.path AND finding.rule_key = 'function-complexity' AND finding.properties->'partial_fingerprints'->>'function.name' = current_metric.symbol AND finding.start_line IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finding.start_line LIMIT 1) function_finding ON TRUE LEFT JOIN quality_function_metric previous_metric ON previous_metric.scan_id = (SELECT scan_id FROM previous_scan) AND previous_metric.metric_key = current_metric.metric_key ORDER BY current_metric.complexity DESC, current_metric.cyclomatic DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Structural & Duplication Findings
panels.description: Actionable Qlty smells other than file/function complexity, which the adjacent risk tables already cover.

targets.rawSql: SELECT finding.level AS "Level", finding.category AS "Category", finding.rule_key AS "Rule", finding.path AS "File", finding.start_line AS "Line", finding.effort_minutes AS "Debt min", finding.message AS "Message", scan.repo, scan.commit_sha, finding.start_line, COALESCE(finding.end_line, finding.start_line) AS end_line, 'Qlty finding' AS selection_kind, finding.rule_key AS selection_label, NULL::integer AS selection_cognitive, NULL::integer AS selection_cyclomatic FROM quality_scan scan JOIN quality_finding finding ON finding.scan_id = scan.scan_id WHERE scan.repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND scan.branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND scan.commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} AND scan.status = 'complete' AND finding.rule_key NOT IN ('file-complexity', 'function-complexity') AND finding.start_line IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE finding.level WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, finding.effort_minutes DESC NULLS LAST, finding.path, finding.start_line LIMIT 200

SELECT suite.framework AS "Framework", suite.name AS "Suite", suite.tests AS "Tests", suite.passed AS "Passed", suite.failures + suite.errors AS "Failed", suite.skipped AS "Skipped", suite.duration_ms AS "Duration ms" FROM ci_run run JOIN test_suite suite ON suite.run_id = run.run_id WHERE run.repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND run.branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND run.commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} ORDER BY suite.failures + suite.errors DESC, suite.duration_ms DESC NULLS LAST

WITH current_scan AS (SELECT scan_id, repo, commit_sha FROM quality_scan WHERE repo = ${repo:sqlstring} AND branch = ${branch:sqlstring} AND commit_sha = ${commit:sqlstring} AND status = 'complete' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT current_scan.repo AS repo, current_scan.commit_sha AS commit, source.path, source.language, source.content AS source, COALESCE(NULLIF(${source_start:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 1) AS start_line, COALESCE(NULLIF(${source_end:sqlstring}, '')::integer, COALESCE(NULLIF(${source_start:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 1)) AS end_line, ${source_kind:sqlstring} AS selection_kind, ${source_label:sqlstring} AS selection_label, NULLIF(${source_cognitive:sqlstring}, '')::integer AS selection_cognitive, NULLIF(${source_cyclomatic:sqlstring}, '')::integer AS selection_cyclomatic, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('startLine', COALESCE(finding.start_line, 1), 'endLine', COALESCE(finding.end_line, finding.start_line, 1), 'level', finding.level, 'category', finding.category, 'ruleKey', finding.rule_key, 'effortMinutes', finding.effort_minutes, 'message', finding.message) ORDER BY finding.start_line) FROM quality_finding finding WHERE finding.scan_id = current_scan.scan_id AND finding.path = source.path), '[]'::jsonb)::text AS finding_annotations FROM current_scan JOIN quality_scan_source scan_source ON scan_source.scan_id = current_scan.scan_id JOIN quality_source source ON source.repo = scan_source.repo AND source.commit_sha = scan_source.commit_sha AND source.path = scan_source.path WHERE source.path = ${source_path:sqlstring}
